Q: Does iverilog implement mailboxes? A:

It does not, and there are no plans to support it according to this issue:

https://github.com/steveicarus/iverilog/issues/314

Q: Why do I get “SyntaxError: invalid syntax” when I type “python helloworld.py” into the terminal? A:

You may be typing into the python interpreter, and the command you're entering isn't valid Python. To exit this mode, you could either press CTRL-D (end of file), or CTRL-C (interrupt program).

(I'm not sure if these key sequences are the same on windows)

If you run the command python without the name of a script file after it, it will start reading user input as if it was a python program.

Q: How to remove the rust_mozprofile used by Selenium A:

I haven't found any reliable way to prevent Geckodriver from leaving its profile folders lying around. The relevant Github issue has been open for a decade, so it probably won't be fixed anytime soon.

If you just need a quick cleanup, here's a CMD command to delete every temporary Geckodriver profile folder:

for /d %f in ("%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\rust_mozprofile??????") do rd /s /q "%f"

Or as a .bat file:

for /d %%f in ("%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\rust_mozprofile??????") do rd /s /q "%%f"
